title: Debate for a weak judge of hidden code
description: A weak judge who cannot inspect a strong model's work hears two strong debaters assigned opposite sides, with an opening and a rebuttal each. Because the debater on the true side can point to evidence the other cannot answer, the judge should reach the truth more often than when it hears a single consultant who was assigned a random side. Here the hidden work is a code submission that is either correct or a working backdoor; debaters can request real executions of the code and quote it, and the judge sees those results verified. Qwen 3.5 397B debates, Gemma 4 31B judges.

source.title: Debating with More Persuasive LLMs Leads to More Truthful Answers
source.authors: Khan, Hughes, Valentine, Ruis, Sachan, Radhakrishnan, Grefenstette, Bowman, Rocktäschel, Perez
